verdict.rationale: The evidence pack details agent identities, MCP/webhook connections, event subscriptions (create_item, change_column_value), and admin controls, but nothing describes scheduling recurring or time-based jobs/workflows for agents — subscriptions are event-triggered, not cron-like recurring automations. Monday.com is a workflow platform where recurring scheduling would be a fair capability to expect, but no evidence confirms it exists for AI-native use.
